comment: Freshwater lakes are environmental features rather than fresh-water material.
Rivers are environmental features rather than water material.
An agricultural ecosystem is a type of environmental system.
A biome is a type of environmental system.
A terrestrial biome is a type of environmental system.
A shoreline is a type of environmental boundary.
A freshwater biome is an environmental system rather than fresh-water material.
Environmental material identifies an environmental source but does not imply a narrower material class.
An anthropogenic terrestrial biome is a type of environmental system.
An urban biome is a type of environmental system.
A freshwater river is an environmental feature rather than fresh-water material.
A temperate mixed broadleaf forest is a type of environmental system.
An anthropised terrestrial environmental zone is a type of environmental source.
An aquatic ecosystem is a type of environmental system.
A human settlement is an anthropised ecosystem.
A waste treatment plant is a constructed environment, but the class is broader than BacCurate's wastewater treatment plant term.
A grocery store is a type of constructed environment.
ENVO's anthropogenic environment includes all systems produced by human activity; built environments are narrower.
Cell culture is in vitro growth in an artificial medium and is therefore a laboratory source.
Mucus material is a type of bodily-fluid material and does not denote anatomy.
Blood serum is both an organism substance and a type of body fluid.
Bodily fluid material consists mainly of bodily fluid or secretion, but it may not be the native fluid.
Because excreta includes urine and feces, it is broader than BacCurate's urine term and cannot resolve to it.
UBERON defines respiratory system fluid/secretion as an organism substance secreted by the respiratory system. However, secretion is only a related synonym.
A tracheal aspirate is a narrower type of collected respiratory secretion. UBERON has no organism-substance class specific to aspirates.
Because excreta includes urine and feces, it is broader than BacCurate's feces term and cannot resolve to it.
A fecal environment is an environmental system determined by feces rather than the sampled feces substance.
The chordate pharynx has the intended respiratory-and-digestive hierarchy but applies to a narrower taxonomic group than BacCurate's unqualified pharynx term.
A digestive tract environment is an environmental system determined by the anatomical digestive tract rather than the anatomical site itself.
An intestine environment is an environmental system determined by the anatomical intestine rather than the anatomical site itself.
UBERON's reproductive system is broader because it includes the gonads. UBERON marks reproductive tract as related rather than exact.
For a body site, bone element is the better semantic fit. UBERON marks bone as related because it can also mean bone tissue.
MONDO's injury class covers damage with or without structural disruption, so it is broader than a sampled wound lesion.
MONDO describes the same surface lesion but classifies it as ulcer disease rather than the sampled structure.
MONDO classifies an abscess as an infectious disease or inflammatory process characterized by a pus-filled cavity rather than the sampled structure.
Manured soil is a subtype of soil.
ENVO defines the root-influenced soil region but classifies it as an ecosystem and part of an astronomical body rather than as soil material.
Surface water is a subtype of liquid water.
River water is a subtype of stream water and liquid water, but it does not require fresh-water salinity.
Hypereutrophic water is a subtype of liquid water.
Urban stormwater is a subtype of stormwater and liquid water.
Farmyard manure is a subtype of animal manure.
Chicken manure is a subtype of poultry manure and animal manure.
A hospital is a type of healthcare facility.
A hospital unit is a type of healthcare facility.
A microbiology hospital unit is a type of healthcare facility.
A veterinary facility is a type of healthcare facility.
A chicken house is a type of animal house used on farms.
ENVO farm includes cultivated or grazing land and agricultural constructions; the BacCurate term denotes only a built farm facility.
A dairy building is a food-production facility used to harvest or process milk for consumption.
ENVO defines a food processing building, but one plant can span more than one building.
Because waste treatment plants include non-wastewater facilities, the class is broader than BacCurate's wastewater treatment plant term and cannot resolve to it.
ENVO's fomite class requires the capacity to transmit infectious organisms and may also denote a substance. BacCurate's term asserts only an inanimate object.
ENVO defines a material surface layer, while a swabbed surface may refer to a boundary or location instead.
Coconut whole or pieces is a subtype of plant food product.
Meat whole or pieces is a subtype of animal food product. Its definition can include crustaceans, so it is not limited to BacCurate's meat-product branch.
Mammalian meat food product is a type of meat product.
Chicken thigh with skin and bone is a type of meat product.
Skinless boneless chicken breast is a type of meat product.
FoodOn's animal meat product has a weak hierarchy that does not preserve BacCurate's meat-versus-seafood split.
